items.caption: A modern redraw of 元 in the seal-script style associated with the received Shuowen tradition.
items.alt: Black seal-script strokes forming 元 on a plain light background.
items.selection_reason: This is the only verified candidate and provides a useful visual example of 元 in a seal-script style. Specialist accounts describe earlier forms as a human figure with a mark at the head, but this redraw does not show those early forms.

limitations.text: This modern seal-script redraw is not an ancient artifact image, so it cannot establish the strokes or meaning of the earliest forms. The early graph is interpreted as a human figure with a mark at the head; the proposed reading of its strokes as 儿 plus 二 is not established.
